name: 7maps
description: Map of public MCP servers for AI agents (software, not geography): find a tool for a job among over 200,000, check a server's status and estimated tool risk before connecting, and see what changed since a person approved it. Works with nothing to set up. Measured October 2026 on Opus 5.5: about 63% fewer tokens per verified answer about MCP servers; details: https://7it.co.il/7maps/plugin/

maps_key.title: 7Maps key (optional)
maps_key.description: Your personal 7Maps key (starts with 7m_) from https://7it.co.il/7maps/me/. It only adds your calls to your own usage numbers there and in my_7maps_usage; it changes nothing about what a call costs. Leave empty to use 7Maps without one.
